text:
rachel (product): Heads-up: BigRetail asks for a conservative reserved-pool option that guarantees burst for checkout routes during BlackFriday windows. They want deterministic preemption, a soft-burst band, and clear billing for bursts. Need scoping for next planning.

diego (eng-platform): Options: (A) per-tenant reserved pool + route mapping, (B) route-priorities on shared pool with strict token guarantees for named routes. (B) is faster.

mina (eng-sre): Ops constraints: preemption should be by route within a tenant rather than by tenant to avoid collateral damage. We need a priority-aware scheduler and an emergency kill-switch. Also require telemetry to prove we honored guarantees.

evan (finance): Billing requires an export with (route, lease_id, tokens_burst, window). Need dispute window and a sample invoice line. Also ask for a minimum monthly commit if they want "no-preempt" days.

rachel (product): Proposed MVP scope: route-priority tags + soft vs hard bands + export for billing. No-preempt days behind a paid flag. Pilot with one customer and two routes.

diego (eng-platform): Rough estimate: 7d to wire metadata into router and scheduler, 3d to add priority-aware batching behavior, 2d for export hooks, 2d dashboards/alerts. ~14d calendar.

mina (eng-sre): Pilot gates: telemetry (p50/p95 by route/priority), preemption audit log, rollback toggle, billing export validated. Ops to run dry-run with synthetic spikes.

hana (customer-success): BigRetail will accept route-level preempt as long as we provide invoice preview and calendar controls in onboarding. They asked for sample SLA credit for missed minutes.

diego (eng-platform): quick config sketch for sandbox:
```
reserved_policy:
  name: bigretail-bf-lease
  routes: ["/checkout/charge", "/checkout/recon"]
  guaranteed_tpm: 180000
  soft_band_tokens: 30000
  preemption: route-level
  no_preempt_days: []
```

mina (eng-sre): Add these dashboards: token_consumption_by_route, preemption_events, fallback_model_count. Also add automated reconciliation test for billing.

evan (finance): I'll draft invoice wording: "Reserved burst (route /checkout/charge): guaranteed N tokens/min during windows; excess billed at $Y per 1k tokens; no-preempt surcharge +Z%. Disputes accepted within 72hrs."

rachel (product): Actions: diego+mina prototype in sandbox this week, evan produce invoice stub, hana confirm acceptance criteria with BigRetail. Decision checkpoint Fri 16:00.

sre-bot: scheduled dry-run in staging at 2025-11-25T03:00:00Z. :gear:

diego (eng-platform): One technical caveat: model-fallback path should be opt-in per route to avoid surprise quality regressions. We'll default to queue+fallback then reject.

rachel (product): Good call. Add Optimize review for fallback quality and add to pilot acceptance.

mina (eng-sre): final note: include test harness that simulates concurrent leases to validate fair eviction order.

rachel (product): Thanks all — I'll create the epic and assign estimates.
